entries.name: overlay.skip
entries.description: Stops current event playback and advances the queue. Applies to all event origins across this owner’s Global Overlay scenes.

entries.name: overlay.skip.twitch
entries.description: Stops current event playback and advances the queue. Applies to twitch events only across this owner’s Global Overlay scenes.

entries.name: overlay.skip.kick
entries.description: Stops current event playback and advances the queue. Applies to kick events only across this owner’s Global Overlay scenes.

entries.name: overlay.pause
entries.description: Holds new playback while the current event finishes. Applies to all event origins across this owner’s Global Overlay scenes.

entries.name: overlay.pause.twitch
entries.description: Holds new playback while the current event finishes. Applies to twitch events only across this owner’s Global Overlay scenes.

entries.name: overlay.pause.kick
entries.description: Holds new playback while the current event finishes. Applies to kick events only across this owner’s Global Overlay scenes.

entries.name: overlay.resume
entries.description: Continues held playback. Applies to all event origins across this owner’s Global Overlay scenes.

entries.name: overlay.resume.twitch
entries.description: Continues held playback. Applies to twitch events only across this owner’s Global Overlay scenes.

entries.name: overlay.resume.kick
entries.description: Continues held playback. Applies to kick events only across this owner’s Global Overlay scenes.

entries.name: overlay.clear
entries.description: Removes pending events while current playback continues. Applies to all event origins across this owner’s Global Overlay scenes.

entries.name: overlay.clear.twitch
entries.description: Removes pending events while current playback continues. Applies to twitch events only across this owner’s Global Overlay scenes.

entries.name: overlay.clear.kick
entries.description: Removes pending events while current playback continues. Applies to kick events only across this owner’s Global Overlay scenes.

entries.name: enable.command
entries.description: Enables a command in this channel. Quote names containing spaces. Optional 1-604800 seconds restores the previous state after the duration, including after restarts. Repeating the same timed change extends it; omitting duration cancels any pending restoration.

entries.name: disable.command
entries.description: Disables a command in this channel. Quote names containing spaces. Optional 1-604800 seconds restores the previous state after the duration, including after restarts. Repeating the same timed change extends it; omitting duration cancels any pending restoration.

entries.name: enable.redemption
entries.description: Enables a redemption in this channel. Quote names containing spaces. Optional 1-604800 seconds restores the previous state after the duration, including after restarts. Repeating the same timed change extends it; omitting duration cancels any pending restoration.

entries.name: disable.redemption
entries.description: Disables a redemption in this channel. Quote names containing spaces. Optional 1-604800 seconds restores the previous state after the duration, including after restarts. Repeating the same timed change extends it; omitting duration cancels any pending restoration.

entries.name: roulette.add
entries.description: Adds an item; multiplier creates copies, weight sets chance per copy.

entries.name: roulette.remove
entries.description: Removes an item and all its copies.

entries.name: roulette.update
entries.description: Updates an item multiplier and optionally its weight.

entries.name: roulette.shuffle
entries.description: Shuffles individual copies without changing odds.

entries.name: roulette.switch
entries.description: Selects the active roulette without changing visibility.

entries.name: roulette.show
entries.description: Shows the active roulette overlay.

entries.name: roulette.hide
entries.description: Hides the roulette overlay without cancelling its draw.

entries.name: roulette.start
entries.description: Starts the active or specified roulette and saves one authoritative winner.

entries.name: roulette.result
entries.description: Returns the most recently completed winner label.

entries.name: user
entries.description: Returns the username of the caller / current chatter. Optional "ignore" filters strip characters from that name: "symbols" removes every character that is not a letter, combining mark or number, "numbers" removes numeric characters. Both filters can be combined in any order, and the name keeps its casing. Returns "viewer" when the filters leave no letters or numbers.

entries.name: touser
entries.description: Returns the target username from the first argument; falls back to the caller when no argument is given.

entries.name: randomuser
entries.description: Returns the name of a random active chatter in the channel.

entries.name: random
entries.description: Returns a random integer from 0 up to max-1. Max defaults to 100.

entries.name: warn
entries.description: Issues an official Twitch warning to a user with a required reason (1-500 characters).
examples: warn someuser Please stop posting spoilers

entries.name: add.vip
entries.description: Grants VIP to a user. Optional days makes it temporary (premium/pro plans only, 1-365 days).

entries.name: unvip
entries.description: Removes VIP from a user.

entries.name: ban
entries.description: Bans or times out a user. Provide seconds for a timeout, omit it for a permanent ban.

entries.name: ban.self
entries.description: AI chat only: bans or times out the verified chatter whose current message broke channel rules. Takes no username. Provide seconds for a timeout; omit for a permanent ban. Cannot affect anyone else.

entries.name: ban.mod
entries.description: Bans/times out a moderator: removes their mod status first, then applies the ban/timeout. With return_mod=true the mod status is restored after the timeout ends (requires a valid timeout). Seconds must be 1-604800. Level 8 applies to bot-driven (AST_PARSER) use; inside streamer-authored commands the command permission level controls who can trigger it.

entries.name: add.mod
entries.description: Grants moderator to a user. Optional days makes it temporary (premium/pro plans only, 1-365 days).

entries.name: unmod
entries.description: Removes moderator from a user.

entries.name: permit
entries.description: Grants a temporary bypass of the channel moderation filters (caps, links, emote spam, blacklist). With a username only that user is permitted; with only a number everyone is permitted for that many seconds; with no arguments everyone is permitted for 60 seconds.

entries.name: clear.chat
entries.description: Clears the entire chat history.

entries.name: emoteonly
entries.description: Toggles emote-only mode on/off. Optional seconds auto-disables it after the duration when enabling.

entries.name: twitch.live
entries.description: Returns true when the channel is live, false when offline or its status cannot be retrieved. Suitable for conditionals.

entries.name: twitch.subs
entries.description: Returns the total subscriber count of the channel.

entries.name: twitch.title
entries.description: Returns the current stream title.

entries.name: twitch.game
entries.description: Returns the current game/category of the stream.

entries.name: twitch.viewers
entries.description: Returns the current viewer count.

entries.name: twitch.follows
entries.description: Returns the total follower count of the channel.

entries.name: twitch.channel
entries.description: Returns the display name of the channel.

entries.name: twitch.login
entries.description: Returns the login name (lowercase, URL-safe) of the channel.

entries.name: count
entries.description: Persistent per-command counter: adds the increment to the stored count and returns the new value.

entries.name: scount
entries.description: Simple counter: increments the per-command count by 1 and returns the new value.

entries.name: bits
entries.description: Returns the bits amount of the current cheer event context (0 outside cheer events).

entries.name: raid
entries.description: Starts a raid to another channel.

entries.name: unraid
entries.description: Cancels an active raid.

entries.name: set.title
entries.description: Changes the stream title.

entries.name: set.game
entries.description: Changes the stream category. Searches Twitch categories by name and picks the best match.

entries.name: set.voice
entries.description: Changes the channel default Fish TTS voice to one of the four built-in voices or a saved favorite. Also selects Fish as the TTS provider. A voice outside this account is rejected.

entries.name: start.prediction
entries.description: Starts a channel points prediction (betting with points). Options are separated by / and the three parts (title, options, seconds) by ;. Requires 2-10 options. The whole argument must be wrapped in double quotes because ; is reserved syntax.

entries.name: get.prediction
entries.description: Reads the current active or locked prediction from Twitch and returns its question and numbered option titles. Call this before end.prediction so the winner matches the question and actual option order.

entries.name: lock.prediction
entries.description: Closes betting on the current prediction without choosing a winner. Already locked predictions are left unchanged.

entries.name: end.prediction
entries.description: Resolves the current active or locked prediction with the exact winning option title or its number (starting at 1). Call get.prediction first to inspect the question and actual option order. The current prediction is fetched again before resolving.

entries.name: cancel.prediction
entries.description: Cancels the current active or locked channel points prediction without choosing a winner. Fetches the current prediction from Twitch.

entries.name: start.poll
entries.description: Starts a native Twitch poll with 2-5 slash-separated options. Separate title, options, seconds, and optional Channel Points cost by semicolons inside double quotes. Omit the cost or use 0 for one free vote per viewer; 1-1000000 enables paid extra votes.

entries.name: get.poll
entries.description: Reads the active poll, or the latest poll when none is active, including its question, status, numbered choices and vote totals.

entries.name: end.poll
entries.description: Ends the current active poll and archives its results. Fetches the current poll from Twitch.

entries.name: cancel.poll
entries.description: Terminates the current active poll without archiving its results. Fetches the current poll from Twitch.

entries.name: ad.time
entries.description: Returns the duration in seconds of the current ad break (event data).

entries.name: ai
entries.description: Generates an AI response for the given prompt using the channel AI personality.

entries.name: create.clip
entries.description: Creates a clip of the current stream moment and returns the clip URL. Optional clip title.

entries.name: followage
entries.description: Returns how long a user has been following the channel (years, months, days, hours). Defaults to the caller.

entries.name: twitch.modiversary
entries.description: Number of months the viewer has been a moderator, from modiversary.months. Returns 0 when no valid moderator anniversary is present.

entries.name: twitch.streak
entries.description: Watch streak count from the current chat notification (watch_streak.streak_count). Returns 0 when no valid watch streak is present.

entries.name: raid.channel
entries.description: Display name of the channel raiding us (raid event data).

entries.name: raid.login
entries.description: Login name of the channel raiding us (raid event data).

entries.name: raid.viewers
entries.description: Number of viewers brought by the incoming raid (raid event data).

entries.name: cheer.amount
entries.description: Bits amount of the current cheer event.

entries.name: cheer.message
entries.description: Text message attached to the current cheer event.

entries.name: sub.tier
entries.description: Subscription tier of the current sub event (Prime, Tier 1, Tier 2, Tier 3).

entries.name: sub.months
entries.description: Cumulative subscription months of the current sub event.

entries.name: gifted.user
entries.description: Recipient username of a gifted subscription event.

entries.name: hypetrain.progress
entries.description: Current hype train progress points.

entries.name: hypetrain.level
entries.description: Current hype train level.

entries.name: hypetrain.end
entries.description: End time of the current hype train.

entries.name: shoutout.channel
entries.description: Target channel of a shoutout event.

entries.name: reward.input
entries.description: User input text from a channel point reward redemption.

entries.name: tts.status
entries.description: Reports the channel speech overlay connection, playing/preparing/idle state and waiting TTS count. Includes Global Overlay Studio. Read-only.

entries.name: tts.connected
entries.description: Returns a boolean: true when a speech overlay or TTS-enabled Studio source is connected. False when disconnected or lookup fails. Read-only.

entries.name: tts.queue.length
entries.description: Returns the number of waiting TTS messages, including retained Studio deliveries, excluding current speech. Duplicate OBS sources count once. Returns -1 if lookup fails. Read-only.

entries.name: tts.skip
entries.description: Stops the current TTS item and advances to the next waiting request.

entries.name: tts.clear
entries.description: Stops current TTS playback and removes all waiting TTS requests.

entries.name: tts.refresh
entries.description: Resets connected speech playback and reconnects overlay sockets, discarding interrupted speech while preserving waiting TTS requests. An offline OBS source must be reopened manually.

entries.name: tts.kokoro
entries.description: Speaks text with a Kokoro preset voice using DeepInfra only. Costs one credit per 15 characters, rounded up; falls back to Piper when credits are exhausted or synthesis fails.

entries.name: tts
entries.description: Speaks a message out loud using the channel default TTS voice.

entries.name: tts.speak
entries.description: Speaks a message using Piper (1 credit per 50 characters, rounded up), including after credit exhaustion.

entries.name: tts.clone
entries.description: Speaks a message with a named Fish Audio cloned voice. First argument is the voice name or voice ID, the rest is the message.

entries.name: pet.talk
entries.description: Speaks supplied text through the pet speech queue without an LLM. Requires a configured command or Twitch event action.

entries.name: pet.ask
entries.description: Asks the pet personality for a reply, then speaks it through the pet speech queue. Requires a configured command or Twitch event action.

entries.name: trigger.send
entries.description: Fires a configured sound/video trigger by name. Optional true/false last argument controls queueing.

entries.name: timer
entries.description: Schedules an unevaluated message and its nested actions after 1-604800 seconds. Returns immediately. Survives bot restarts in cache; overdue jobs run within a 10-minute grace period, then expire. Each invocation creates a separate timer; execution is at most once.

entries.name: delay
entries.description: Pauses execution for the given number of seconds (0-60). Used to sequence multi-step command flows.

entries.name: break
entries.description: Exits the current loop immediately.

entries.name: continue
entries.description: Skips the rest of the current loop iteration and continues with the next one.

entries.name: announce
entries.description: Sends a Twitch announcement. Optional first word selects blue, green, orange, purple or primary; default primary. Message must be 1-500 characters.

entries.name: chat.send
entries.description: Sends a message to chat as the bot.

entries.name: bot.mode
entries.description: Follow-defense control: "attack" queues attack mode, "status" reports the current defense mode and time remaining.

entries.name: pin.create
entries.description: Sends a message to chat and pins it. Optional duration in seconds (30-1800) as first argument.

entries.name: pin.update
entries.description: Updates the duration of the currently pinned message (30-1800 seconds).

entries.name: pin.del
entries.description: Unpins the currently pinned chat message.

entries.name: upper
entries.description: Converts text to UPPERCASE.

entries.name: lower
entries.description: Converts text to lowercase.

entries.name: title
entries.description: Converts text to Title Case (first letter of each word capitalized).

entries.name: capitalize
entries.description: Capitalizes only the first character of the text.

entries.name: trim
entries.description: Removes leading and trailing whitespace from text.

entries.name: length
entries.description: Returns the character count of the text.

entries.name: slice
entries.description: Extracts a substring by index. Negative indexes wrap from the end. Numeric args come first, then the text.

entries.name: replace
entries.description: Literal replace-all of a search string with a replacement (no regex). Quote multi-word search/replacement.
